title: WhatsApp Backup: Local & Cloud
summary: Automatic WhatsApp backups with history, cloud storage and easy restore
description:
Better WhatsApp Backup is the easiest way to create automatic WhatsApp backups and WhatsApp Business backups to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Synology, Amazon S3 and more.

Unlike WhatsApp's built-in backup, Better WhatsApp Backup lets you choose where your backups are stored, when they run, how long they're kept, and how they're restored. Create local backups, cloud backups, or both for complete protection against accidental deletion, phone loss, or failed restores.

BACK UP YOUR WHATSAPP DATA

• WhatsApp chat history
• WhatsApp Business chat history
• Voice notes
• Photos and videos
• Documents and audio files
• Video notes

Store your WhatsApp backups locally, in the cloud, or in multiple locations at the same time.

SUPPORTED CLOUD STORAGE

• Google Drive
• Dropbox
• Microsoft OneDrive
• Synology Drive
• Amazon S3
• WebDAV (Nextcloud, ownCloud and self-hosted servers)
• Local folders and SD cards

AUTOMATIC WHATSAPP BACKUPS

• Daily, weekly or monthly schedules
• Run backups at a time you choose
• Wi-Fi only or mobile data
• Charging-only mode
• Multiple backup profiles

RESTORE WHATSAPP BACKUPS

Restore from any previous backup using full point-in-time recovery. Recover chats, media and documents from cloud or local storage, even when moving to a new phone.

SECURE AND PRIVATE

• Optional end-to-end encryption
• Encrypted chat archives
• No accounts required
• No tracking or analytics
• Your data stays under your control

SMART RETENTION

Automatically keep daily, weekly and monthly backup versions. Maintain a complete WhatsApp backup history while controlling storage usage.

WHY BETTER WHATSAPP BACKUP?

• Multiple cloud providers
• Automatic scheduled backups
• Local and cloud storage
• Full backup history
• Easy restore
• End-to-end encryption
• WhatsApp Business support

Protect your WhatsApp conversations with reliable automatic backups, flexible cloud storage and complete control over your data.
